title: Boolean-selected vertex value
statement: Let a counting-algorithm state have inner vertex $u$ and outer vertex $v$, and let $b$ be Boolean. The register vector entry at the index selected by $b$ is $u$ if $b$ is true and $v$ if $b$ is false.
replaced:
For any register state and Boolean $b$, the value of the register selected by $b$ is $u$
when $b$ is true and $v$ when $b$ is false.
